E0156

This operation would loosen {plane}

What

This operation would loosen {plane}

Why

Knowledge only tightens silently; loosening {plane} must be named with a written gate

Fix

Write `{gate}(value)` at this boundary

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0156: tests/ui/knowledge_loss_range.stderr.
